CustomField.formula: HYPERLINK( "https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=" & SUBSTITUTE(BillingStreet, " ", "+") & "," & SUBSTITUTE(BillingPostalCode, " ", "+") & "+" & SUBSTITUTE(BillingCity, " ", "+") & "," & SUBSTITUTE(BillingCountry, " ", "+"), "Ver en Google Maps", "_blank" )
CustomField.label: Link Google Maps
